name: cloudploy
description: Deploy an app onto a server in your own cloud account.

interface.shortDescription: Deploy an app onto your own server
interface.longDescription: Connect a cloud account, attach a git repository, and deploy an app onto a server you own. CloudPloy uses the team you sign in to. Destructive deletes stay behind an explicit confirmation.
defaultPrompt: List the servers on my CloudPloy team.

positive.description: List servers on the signed-in team
positive.prompt: What servers are on my CloudPloy team?
positive.expected_behavior: Return the servers on the signed-in team, including status.

positive.prompt: Can this team deploy right now?
positive.expected_behavior: Return plan headroom and connected providers. If a paid plan is missing, point at https://cloudploy.com/pricing and the CloudPloy console. Do not open checkout.

positive.prompt: What would a small server cost before I create one?
positive.expected_behavior: Return the provider rate and do not provision a server.
Return auth_url and tell the person to open it. Do not ask for a personal access token.
Deploy an app that already exists on the signed-in team and report the deployment.

negative.expected_behavior: Do not call terminate_server until the person confirms. terminate_server requires confirm=true.

negative.prompt: Show me the server from a team I don't belong to.
negative.expected_behavior: The call fails. Say the server is not on this team. Do not try other ids.

negative.description: Refuse to start a subscription in chat
negative.prompt: Start a CloudPloy subscription and take my card.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not collect payment details or open checkout. Tell them to review https://cloudploy.com/pricing and subscribe in the CloudPloy console.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or start a subscription. People sign in to an account they already have.

publication.release_notes: First directory release. Deploy, git connect, and server inspect tools. No checkout inside chat.
